body.description: Chuy, a wiry lookout in his thirties who watches the road north: a mustard-yellow bandana tied over his head, sun-bleached denim shirt with the sleeves cut off, patched brown trousers, a coil of rope over one shoulder, a long steel pipe resting on the other, squinting watchful face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
